mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL((SELECT CARBON_ROAD_TCO2 + CARBON_TREE_TCO2 FROM carbon_tbl c WHERE c.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID AND c.CARBON_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(CARBON_YEAR) FROM carbon_tbl c2 WHERE c2.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID)), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT CARBON_ELE_TOT FROM carbon_ele_tbl e WHERE e.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT CARBON_GAS_TOT FROM carbon_gas_tbl g WHERE g.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT CARBON_HEAT_TOT FROM carbon_heat_tbl h WHERE h.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID), 0) AS total_emission FROM ctpvsgg_tbl r WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(r.CTPV_NM, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE(#{ctpv}, ' ', '')) AND LOWER(REPLACE(r.SGG_NM, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE(#{sgg}, ' ', ''))

SELECT CONCAT(latest_year, '-01') AS period, IFNULL(e.CARBON_ELE_JAN, 0) + IFNULL(g.CARBON_GAS_JAN, 0) + IFNULL(h.CARBON_HEAT_JAN, 0) + IFNULL(road_tree, 0) / 12 AS emission FROM ( SELECT r.CTPVSGG_ID, (SELECT MAX(CARBON_YEAR) FROM carbon_tbl c2 WHERE c2.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID) AS latest_year, (SELECT IFNULL(c.CARBON_ROAD_TCO2, 0) + IFNULL(c.CARBON_TREE_TCO2, 0) FROM carbon_tbl c WHERE c.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID AND c.CARBON_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(CARBON_YEAR) FROM carbon_tbl c2 WHERE c2.CTPVSGG_ID = r.CTPVSGG_ID)) AS road_tree FROM ctpvsgg_tbl r WHERE LOWER(REPLACE(r.CTPV_NM, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE(#{ctpv}, ' ', '')) AND LOWER(REPLACE(r.SGG_NM, ' ', '')) = LOWER(REPLACE(#{sgg}, ' ', '')) ) reg LEFT JOIN carbon_ele_tbl e ON e.CTPVSGG_ID = reg.CTPVSGG_ID LEFT JOIN carbon_gas_tbl g ON g.CTPVSGG_ID = reg.CTPVSGG_ID LEFT JOIN carbon_heat_tbl h ON h.CTPVSGG_ID = reg.CTPVSGG_ID
UNION ALL

SELECT IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.CARBON_ROAD_TCO2 + c.CARBON_TREE_TCO2) FROM carbon_tbl c JOIN ( SELECT CTPVSGG_ID, MAX(CARBON_YEAR) AS latest_year FROM carbon_tbl GROUP BY CTPVSGG_ID ) latest ON c.CTPVSGG_ID = latest.CTPVSGG_ID AND c.CARBON_YEAR = latest.latest_year), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT SUM(CARBON_ELE_TOT) FROM carbon_ele_tbl), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT SUM(CARBON_GAS_TOT) FROM carbon_gas_tbl), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT SUM(CARBON_HEAT_TOT) FROM carbon_heat_tbl), 0) AS total_emission
